homePage.optimizeProfileATS: Optimize Your Profile for ATS Systems
homePage.atsOptimizerDesc: Our AI-powered ATS Optimizer analyzes your resume and portfolio against the latest applicant tracking systems. Get real-time feedback on keywords, formatting, and content optimization to ensure your profile ranks at the top of employer searches.

homePage.missionDesc2: From NEOM's groundbreaking architecture to emerging tech startups, we're the trusted network enabling Saudi talent to shape the future of work, innovation, and economic growth.

pricingPage.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricingPage.subtitle: Choose the perfect plan for your needs
pricingPage.heroDesc: Join the elite tier of Saudi talent. From AI-driven ATS optimization to exclusive high-stakes roles, BidJobs provides the tools for Vision 2030 excellence.
pricingPage.atsDesc: Our ATS Optimizer analyzes your CV against high-tier job descriptions in real-time, suggesting keywords and structural changes to ensure you land in the Shortlist pile 95% of the time.
pricingPage.atsKeywordDesc: Matches your experience with regional industry standards.
pricingPage.atsStructureDesc: Ensures formatting is readable by all major HR software.
pricingPage.faqQ1: Can I cancel my Elite Professional subscription at any time?
pricingPage.faqA1: Yes. We believe in the value of our product. You can cancel your monthly subscription at any time with no hidden fees or locked contracts.
pricingPage.faqQ2: Does the ATS Optimizer work for Arabic CVs?
pricingPage.faqA2: Absolutely. Our system is fully localized for Saudi Vision 2030, supporting both Modern Standard Arabic and English industry terminology.
